title: backlog.py new bug refuses a repro whose program check refuses
goal: Retrospective of SP-qxcj7fgy: ST-7avb5uo6's worker filed BG-77i2lwmr with a grep repro that new accepted, then land stopped at the sync gate (backlog.py check errors=1, three test_land_e2e tests that copy the backlog) until the orchestrator rewrote the repro on the branch, because the worker's backlog.py check had run before the filing. new bug, set --repro and set --check refuse a program that bl_intake.check_program_refusal refuses, with exit 2 and nothing written, so a worker's filed bug never fails the landing gate; new refuses python3 -I -c the same way, with the refusal's reason; a --repro or --check value with an unclosed quote (echo it's) exits 2 with a usage error naming the option and writes no item, not a ValueError traceback from shlex.split in bl_items.parse_cmd

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
live = os.getcwd(); t = tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', t], check=True)
d = t + '/kb/_self/backlog'; os.makedirs(d)
b = [sys.executable, live + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', t]
p = subprocess.run(b + ['new', 'bug', '--title', 'b', '--severity', 'S3', '--goal', 'g', '--repro', 'grep -q zzzzqqqq _tools/backlog.py', '--repro-reason', 'the defect is a docstring line'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=t)
sys.exit(0 if p.returncode == 2 and os.listdir(d) == [] else 1)

import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
live = os.getcwd(); t = tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', t], check=True)
d = t + '/kb/_self/backlog'; os.makedirs(d)
b = [sys.executable, live + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', t]
def run(*a): return subprocess.run(b + list(a), capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=t)
i = run('new', 'story', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g').stdout.split()[2]
before = {n: open(d + '/' + n).read() for n in os.listdir(d)}
bad = ['python3', '-I', '-c', 'import sys; sys.exit(1)']
r1 = run('new', 'bug', '--title', 'b', '--severity', 'S3', '--goal', 'g', '--repro', __import__('shlex').join(bad))
r2 = run('set', i, '--check', __import__('shlex').join(bad))
after = {n: open(d + '/' + n).read() for n in os.listdir(d)}
sys.exit(0 if r1.returncode == 2 and r2.returncode == 2 and after == before else 1)

import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
live = os.getcwd(); t = tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', t], check=True)
d = t + '/kb/_self/backlog'; os.makedirs(d)
b = [sys.executable, live + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', t]
def run(*a): return subprocess.run(b + list(a), capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=t)
q = "echo it" + chr(39) + "s"
rs = [run('new', 'bug', '--title', 't', '--severity', 'S3', '--goal', 'g', '--repro', q),
      run('new', 'story', '--title', 't', '--goal', 'g', '--check', q)]
ok = all(r.returncode == 2 and 'Traceback' not in r.stderr for r in rs) and os.listdir(d) == []
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
